subject: Urgent shift for Thursday's planning call
text:
Hi everyone,

I'm sorry for the quick notice, but we need to move tomorrow's planning call because the facilities inspection came through an hour earlier than expected. I'm stuck in the corridor with a contractor, reviewing the outlet placement and cable route, and I won't be back at my desk until late morning. The original slot no longer works, especially since the vendor quote update is due by noon and we still need to compare it against the first rough estimate.

Could we shift to Wednesday at 2:30 instead? If that lands badly for any of you, please send one or two possible half-hour windows as soon as you can. I'm happy to work around the rest of the group, and I'll keep the agenda unchanged: venue questions, catering notes, and a final check on the budget.

If nothing changes, I'll move the calendar invite and mark the old meeting as tentative. Please also flag whether anyone needs the spreadsheet link refreshed before we talk, since the totals shifted after last night's revision.

Also, if the inspection runs over, I may only join for the first part, so please do not wait for me on the budget slides. I will share any updates immediately if my availability changes, and I appreciate everyone catching up asynchronously if a live conversation is not possible for now.

Thanks for your flexibility, and I'm sorry again for the scramble.

Best,
